Yuzvendra Chahal Retires from First-Class Cricket

Indian spinner Yuzvendra Chahal has announced his retirement from first-class cricket. The leg-spinner, known for his white-ball prowess, stated his desire to focus on returning to the Indian One Day International and T20 squads. His red-ball career concluded, with one outlet noting his last first-class match was at Lord's.
